observations: body L1-L30: the end of the entry on pp. 288 and 289, begun on p. XXV; the Addenda to the first volume end with this page.
body L2: ☾ and ⊙ are the signs of the Moon and the Sun.
body L4-L5, L7-L8: the computations of Barhebraeus, centred on their lines; the signs = are printed long (10.2-10.8 pt).
body L7: the cube of 60′ : 17′ 33″ is 39.96; the print has 39 1/4.
body L8: the cube of 5 1/2 is 166 3/8, printed 166 1/4 1/8; 166 3/8 × 39 1/4 = 6530.2, where the print has 6644.
body L9, L22: paragraphs beginning inside the entry. The hyphens of «222-32» and «193-200» (L9) measure 4.2 and 3.2 pt.

body L12-L14: the angular diameters of the five planets in two pairs of columns, set at the printed positions of the columns; the fractions are stacked, and the ditto marks «»» repeat «diametri Solis».
body L15-L30: «Hipparcho», «Ptole-» «maeo», «Hipparchus», «Ptolemaeus» (L18), «Ptolemaei», «Nau», «Ptolemaeo» and «Barhebraeus» are letter-spaced; «al-Battānī» (L21) is not.

body L18, L22, L26: the Syriac word «ܢܣܝܪ̈ܐ», with the prefix ܕ in L18, is printed in a West Syriac (Serto) type without vowels; the two dots of the plural stand over the rēsh. The edition sets it in an Estrangela type. In L22 it stands at the right end of the line.
body L20: the omission is marked by five spaced dots; the dash measures 10.4 pt.
body L23: «الثمرة» has the three dots of the thā’ and the two of the tā’ marbūṭa; «Καρπός» has the acute on the ο.
body L26-L29: «ktābā da-nsīrē», «al-manshūrāt» and «manāshīr» are italic; «serrā» has the macron of the ablative.

notes_left L1-L12, notes_right L1-L12: three notes in two columns with a thin rule between them; note 3 runs from the left column into the right. «Barhebraeus» (notes_left L1, notes_right L7), «al-Battānī», «al-Bīrūnī», «Nau» and «Ptolemaeus» are letter-spaced.

notes_left L6-L8: the small fractions read at 6000 dpi: 1/20, 4/81, 5/109, 1/24, 2/65, 1/36. The small 2 prints heavily, its bowl closed, so that it looks like an 8; the 6 of «36» prints with its top closed.
notes_left L11: «b-ōrganōn trayānāy peshḥā» is italic, with a space before the comma that follows it.
notes_right L1: the hyphen of «321-322» measures 2.9 pt; the t of «t. I» prints broken.

notes_right L5-L6: the Greek of the Almagest. The breathing before the capital of «Ἰππάρχου» is printed as a smooth breathing; the name has the rough breathing (Ἱππάρχου). «ὑποδεδειγμένην» and «ὑπὸ» have the rough breathing.
notes_right L8: the dash measures 6.5 pt.
notes_right L9: the 9 of «209» prints broken.
notes_right L11-L12: the omission is marked by five spaced dots; «nqābā» is italic.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
